chapter: With Chick Webb and Ella Fitzgerald, 1936-39
title: Don Kirkpatrick and Tommy Fulford
summary: Kirkpatrick was a fine arranger who stayed home when the band travelled, replaced by Tommy Fulford in late 1936.
